final_model.selection: higher mean CV macro-F1 of gb vs gb_balanced

method_comparison.folds: same 5 StratifiedGroupKFold folds as "cv" (by user_id, random_state=42)

method_a.description: argmax(w_c * p_c), w_maintain = 1; w_demote, w_promote grid-searched on inner out-of-fold probabilities (nested)

method_c.description: GradientBoostingRegressor on next_accuracy, clipped to [0, 1], then label thresholds

method_comparison.decision_rule: ML replaces persistence iff mean macro-F1 - persistence mean macro-F1 > max(method std, persistence std); fixed before results were seen

deployed_model_3feature_superseded.method: A: unweighted GB classifier + tuned class multipliers
deployed_model_3feature_superseded.rationale: Panel requires an ML model in the live analysis. Method A ties the persistence baseline (CV macro-F1 0.537 +/- 0.012 vs 0.537 +/- 0.010); it is deployed with persistence reported as the baseline. No claim is made that ML beats the baseline.

reduced_model_evaluation.method: A on reduced features: unweighted GB + nested tuned class multipliers
reduced_model_evaluation.dropped_reason: avg_attempts is measured differently in the quiz (answer changes) than in ASSISTments (tries until correct); found by the validity grid check on quiz-like inputs BEFORE the reduced model was evaluated.
reduced_model_evaluation.time_floor: avg_time_sec raised to the training fold's 5% quantile (train and test)
reduced_model_evaluation.folds: same 5 StratifiedGroupKFold folds as "cv" (by user_id, random_state=42)
reduced_model_evaluation.decision_rule: non-inferiority, fixed before results were seen: deploy if mean macro-F1 >= persistence mean macro-F1 - max(std_B, std_persistence)

deployed_model.method: A: unweighted GB classifier + tuned class multipliers (reduced features)
deployed_model.dropped_reason: avg_attempts is measured differently in the quiz (answer changes) than in ASSISTments (tries until correct); found by the validity grid check on quiz-like inputs BEFORE the reduced model was evaluated.
deployed_model.input_floor_rule: 5% quantile of training avg_time_sec, stored in the model
deployed_model.rationale: Panel requires an ML model in the live analysis. Non-inferior to the persistence baseline under the pre-registered rule; deployed with persistence reported as the baseline. No claim is made that ML beats the baseline.
